narrative: Today's tech landscape highlights significant policy changes impacting data centers, groundbreaking advancements in quantum computing, and the continuous evolution of space technology. AI continues its global expansion with localized pricing strategies, while foundational cloud services mark key milestones, underpinning modern digital infrastructure.

highlights.title: New York becomes the first state to enact a data center moratorium
highlights.whyItMatters: This marks a significant policy shift impacting the growth of technology infrastructure and AI development.

highlights.title: PsiQuantum has a plan to make a massive quantum computer out of light
highlights.whyItMatters: Advancements in quantum computing could revolutionize data processing and scientific research.

highlights.title: YouTrackDB is a general-use object-oriented graph database
highlights.whyItMatters: New database technologies can improve data management and application development for developers.

highlights.title: SpaceX is gearing up for Starship's 13th test flight later this week
highlights.whyItMatters: Continued progress in reusable rocket technology is crucial for space exploration and satellite deployment.

highlights.title: Amazon SQS turns 20: Two decades of reliable messaging at scale
highlights.whyItMatters: AWS SQS reaching a two-decade milestone highlights the longevity and critical role of foundational cloud services in distributed systems.

highlights.title: Anthropic starts localizing Claude pricing for India, its biggest market after the US
highlights.whyItMatters: AI companies are expanding global market reach through localized strategies, increasing accessibility and adoption.

highlights.title: NASA’s Hubble Discovers First of Star Cluster’s Missing Black Holes
highlights.whyItMatters: This discovery enhances our understanding of stellar evolution and the dynamics of star clusters.
